entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Mark. Pulling that up now... I see the order for the Pro-Lite road cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
They're just not right. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but I still get terrible blisters after every ride. They're useless to me.

I'm very sorry to hear that the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I see here that the order was delivered about 62 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay, yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file.
Fine. So I just send them back?

That's right. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Also, I see that you're a VIP member with us, Mark. For the trouble you've had, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
